title: Rav Shimi bar Ukva
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Berakhot 10a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.10a.21) describes him as frequently sitting before Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi, who would arrange aggadic teachings before Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi. This last clause refers to Shimon ben Pazi, not Shimi bar Ukva, as cited in Dikdukei Soferim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Hebrew also gives Mar Ukva as an alternative and leaves the subject of “would arrange the aggadah” implicit.

Hyman takes the subject to be Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi, as does the Davidson English. The wording in [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3299&lang=en) can be read as continuing with Shimi or Mar Ukva as the subject.
